result_semantic_payload.summary: The hypothesis that employee 'lihua' exported the customer database on 2024-05-10 is NOT supported by the recorded evidence and is, on the available record, contradicted. The application log at /export/app.log attributes the 2024-05-10 customer-database export to the dedicated non-interactive service account 'svc_export', triggered by the scheduled job 'nightly_export' (defined as running daily at 23:55 in /scheduler/jobs.conf). The export began 2024-05-10 01:03:22, wrote 184,112 rows to /backup/customers_20240510.tar.gz, and completed successfully at 01:03:40 (18 s). The only 'lihua' activity in the log is two FAILED logins from 198.51.100.44 at 01:47:11 and 01:47:59 (reason=password), ~44 minutes AFTER the export had already completed; a failed authentication cannot perform the export. Note: the delegated scope was labelled 'windows', but the underlying image is a general-forensics (TSK) capture with no Windows source scopes registered, so no Windows logon, prefetch/amcache, registry or event-log evidence was available to corroborate or refute the hypothesis beyond the three files present.

claim_candidates.text: On 2024-05-10 the customer-database export was performed by the service account 'svc_export' (EXPORT account=svc_export dataset=customers rows=184112 dest=/backup/customers_20240510.tar.gz at 01:03:22, status=success duration=18s at 01:03:40).

The export was triggered by the scheduled job 'nightly_export' running as account svc_export (log line '2024-05-09 23:55:01 SCHEDULE job=nightly_export account=svc_export triggered'), matching the daily 23:55 schedule defined in /scheduler/jobs.conf.

The only recorded 'lihua' activity on 2024-05-10 consists of two FAILED logins from 198.51.100.44 at 01:47:11 and 01:47:59 with reason=password; no successful lihua session and no lihua-attributed export action appear anywhere in the captured evidence.

The analyst hypothesis that lihua exported the customer database on 2024-05-10 is not supported and is contradicted by the evidence: the export completed at 01:03:40, roughly 44 minutes before lihua's first (failed) login attempt, and no lihua-attributed EXPORT event exists. The actual exporter is the automated nightly_export job running under svc_export.

The two failed lihua logins from 198.51.100.44 shortly after the export could indicate an unrelated brute-force/password-guess attempt, or an actor probing the account after the scheduled export; the captured evidence does not establish intent or attribution.
limitations: No authentication logs, terminal services logs or network flow data captured; 198.51.100.44 cannot be attributed to a person or host from this evidence alone.

limitations: Delegated source scope was 'windows', but the task registered no Windows source scopes (platforms=[], source_scopes=[]) and the image is a general-forensics TSK capture; no Windows event-log, registry, prefetch or amcache data was available.

No evidence was captured after 2024-05-10 01:47:59, so later lihua activity or remediation is out of scope of the record.
warnings: Hypothesis-refuting conclusion rests on a single application log; absence of a lihua-attributed EXPORT event is an argument from silence and should be treated as strong but not conclusive.

The 44-minute gap between the completed export (01:03:40) and lihua's failed logins (01:47:11/01:47:59) is temporally suspicious but the evidence does not establish any link between lihua and the export.
Scope mismatch: the request targeted Windows-derived evidence, which does not exist in this task; findings are therefore based on generic file/log evidence only.
